rules: Allowlisted existing local test/check logs only; no server, config, environment or production logs.
Replace /workspace/Memoh with <repo> and /workspace/.memoh-cloud/go with <cloud-go-toolchain>. No other text replacements.
Go files keep every JSON event and Output string; no Output decoding or event filtering. Only the above literal path substitutions can differ from raw JSONL bytes.
quality-checks.txt concatenates full selected outputs with source headers, except web-build retains only its final warning/success tail. It is an assembled excerpt, not a raw log.
Empty server-build output has no independent exit-status proof; previously observed exit status is recorded in the checkpoint narrative.
